"""Temporary repro for models.E015 false positive on ordering = ['option__pk']."""
import django
from django.conf import settings

settings.configure(
    INSTALLED_APPS=['django.contrib.contenttypes', 'django.contrib.auth'],
    DATABASES={'default': {'ENGINE': 'django.db.backends.sqlite3', 'NAME': ':memory:'}},
)
django.setup()

from django.db import models

class Option(models.Model):
    class Meta:
        app_label = 'repro'

class SomeModel(models.Model):
    option = models.ForeignKey(Option, models.CASCADE)
    class Meta:
        app_label = 'repro'
        ordering = ['option__pk']

class BadModel(models.Model):
    option = models.ForeignKey(Option, models.CASCADE)
    class Meta:
        app_label = 'repro'
        ordering = ['option__bogus_lookup']

def e015(model):
    return [e for e in model.check() if e.id == 'models.E015']

errs = e015(SomeModel)
print('ordering=["option__pk"]  -> E015 errors:', errs)
assert not errs, 'E015 falsely raised for ordering=["option__pk"]'

errs_bad = e015(BadModel)
print('ordering=["option__bogus_lookup"] -> E015 errors:', errs_bad)
assert errs_bad, 'E015 no longer catches genuinely bad related lookups'

print('OK: related __pk accepted, bogus related lookup still rejected')
